{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm no QA orders exist
qa_orders_mask = data['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == '999999.99'): {qa_orders_mask.sum()}")

# Check for any revenue values with commas
contains_comma = data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of revenue values containing commas: {contains_comma.sum()}")

# Check if any of the values with commas are actually valid numbers
comma_values = data.loc[contains_comma, 'revenue']
print(f"Values containing commas: {comma_values.tolist()}")

# Check if any of them are actually '999,999.99' or similar
is_999k = data['revenue'].str.contains('999,999.99', na=False)
print(f"Number of rows with '999,999.99': {is_999k.sum()}")"}
